question: Does the pre-soft-s RTK archive already source-lock a representation of the new rank-one scalar carrier under the projectable gravitational gauge symmetry strongly enough to remove the s6fZ5 interface ambiguity without a post-hoc charge assignment?
required_representation_data: an explicit pre-soft-s identification of the two scalar carrier fields or an equivalent physical/null pair
their transformation law under every local gauge symmetry of the projectable gravitational parent
a source-locked shared normal derivative or invariant-shift prescription using the same lapse/shift variables
a source-locked cross-symmetry closure statement sufficient to derive rather than choose the combined scalar lapse/shift source

decision_rule.REPRESENTATION_SOURCE_LOCKED_PASS_SCOPED: All required representation/interface data are explicit in pre-soft-s sources and require no new charge assignment.
decision_rule.NO_PRE_SOFTS_REPRESENTATION_FOUND_PASS_S: At least one required datum is absent; record the missing items and keep the interface blocked without inventing a representation.
decision_rule.FAIL_SCOPED: Frozen source assertions are internally inconsistent.
